name: Intent Yield

brand.tagline: For a given unit of human input, the output that stays true: an autonomous system on Ultrastable, the foundation for any autonomous system.

idea: Each owner directive is one intent; its own probe passing, unrestated, after 30 days is one kept outcome. No counts and no person scored.
goals: Every owner directive has a kept, broken or unmeasured verdict, recomputed daily
Restatements are charged to the original directive
A directive that is not holding becomes a queue item closed by its own probe
positioning: Intent Yield measures what an autonomous system makes of its owner's words, without paying out in counts.
